name: touchHLE iOS (Unofficial)
subtitle: Experimental touchHLE port for modern iPhones
description: An unofficial iOS port of touchHLE, running the HyperHLE core for broader game compatibility. JIT and legally obtained decrypted 32-bit IPAs are required. Games are not included.

apps.name: touchHLE
apps.subtitle: Run supported early 32-bit iPhone games
apps.localizedDescription: A native iOS port of touchHLE running the HyperHLE v1.0.6 core, with IPA importing, artwork, persistent saves, orientation handling, a return-to-library control, and optional FPS display. JIT must be enabled for each new app process. No games are included.

versions.localizedDescription: Moves to the HyperHLE v1.0.6 core. Fixes landscape touch input, landscape orientation, and resolution scaling.
